candidate.family: authorization bypass via path canonicalization mismatch (CWE-41/178/863)

verified.exploit_entry_point: HTTP GET to a static resource served from the application classpath after the Quarkus router has applied path-based HTTP permission rules
variants: /api%2Fadmin%2Fadmin.html and /api%2Fsecret%2Fsecret.html: encoded path separator hides a protected prefix from the permission matcher while the static handler resolves and serves the file
/api/admin%2Fadmin.html, /api/secret%2Fsecret.html, /api%2fadmin%2fadmin.html: same shape with the encoded separator in a different position or case
/api%2Finternal%2Finternal.html: same shape against the static-content exclusion rule added by the task injection

/secure/admin%3B/x, /secure/admin%3Bx/y, /secure/admin%00/x, /secure/admin%2Fx: encoded matrix-parameter / null-byte / separator spellings that the servlet container maps into a constrained servlet subtree while the servlet security policy does not see the constraint

/api/secure/..;/open/data: canonicalising the request path moves a request the router still serves from the admin prefix into a permitted prefix (the natural decode + removeDots implementation does this)
routes: main application router, HTTP permissions applied to classpath static resources
servlet deployment descriptor security constraints applied to a servlet mapped below a constraint pattern
verified.project_tests_run: extensions/vertx-http/deployment ConfigBasedPathMatchingHttpSecurityPolicyTest (130 tests) and extensions/undertow/deployment ServletWebXmlSecurityTestCase; both pass in the image at the pinned+injected commit and after the reference fix

wrong_fix_catalogue.refuse_all: n/a: a refuse-all fix cannot pass the functional group's public-resource and authorised-access tests; a dedicated patch adds nothing
wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: every security test requires a 4xx client error and no protected content, so a crash or 500 cannot satisfy it
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: each security test checks the exact protected resource's marker and the authorisation decision for that resource; a proxy or neighbouring resource is not accepted
wrong_fix_catalogue.one_role_or_direction: n/a: the functional group exercises anonymous, non-admin and admin callers against the same resources, and the security group covers the encoded spellings for both the admin and the authenticated rule
wrong_fix_catalogue.reads_only: n/a: the protected resources in this task are only read (HTTP GET); a read guard is the whole requirement
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the bypass happens before any credential is parsed, and no security test supplies malformed credentials
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no external authority or secret is consulted; every rule is local configuration
wrong_fix_catalogue.adjacent_api: n/a: the reference fix adds a new helper and leaves the existing shared helper's contract unchanged; pass_alternative.patch shows a second valid design is accepted

traps.shape: a path-based exclusion rule for static content is evaluated on the raw normalised request path while the handler resolves the resource from the decoded path
traps.realistic_because: operator-facing static-resource settings live next to the serving code; the rule is a plain prefix check a maintainer could add to that recorder without going through the security utility

traps.shape: decoding and removing dot segments moves a request that the router still serves from a protected prefix into a permitted prefix, so matching only the canonical path grants access
traps.realistic_because: the natural canonicalisation implementation (repeated decode plus removeDots) has exactly this effect on a path such as /api/secure/..;/open/data, which the router still routes to the secure handler

traps.shape: servlet security constraints are matched against the partially decoded request path while the servlet container maps the decoded path into the constrained subtree
traps.realistic_because: real, unmodified upstream code: a second authorization implementation in a separate extension, with its own matching semantics

notes: Injected track: StaticPathRules/StaticResourcesConfig/StaticResourcesRecorder are the added sibling gap; the published fix's far sites in the OIDC multitenancy resolver, the Keycloak policy enforcer and the REST CSRF filter are included in the reference fix but not exercised by the hidden tests because they need an external provider/service or do not reproduce through a request path that a handler resolves differently (see notes.md). Register: no Pattern B rows (the screener's O8 was empty and no unmodified upstream route was used as an uncovered route).
